title: Interview frame
prompt: You have 45 minutes. A candidate starts drawing 12 microservices before asking QPS or durability. What do you coach them to do?

choices.label: Stop the sketch; run clarify → size → one path → deepen risk
choices.consequence: The frame grades judgment; boxes without bounds are theater.

choices.label: Praise the breadth and ask for five more services
choices.consequence: More boxes without a path waste the bottleneck minutes.

choices.label: Make them pick Postgres vs Cassandra next
choices.consequence: Vendor choice before requirements locks the wrong axis.

choices.label: Tell them estimates are optional fluff
choices.consequence: Orders of magnitude steer which risks matter.
